title: About me
text:
My name is Yangyin Zeng. I am currently studying biology and developing my skills in data analysis, programming, and reproducible research.
I am especially interested in using computational tools to make biological and public health questions easier to explore, explain, and share.

title: About me
text:
Research and Academic Interests
I am interested in biology, immunology, infectious disease, and how data analysis can help answer biological and public health questions.

title: About me
text:
Data Analysis Experience
I have some experience using R and RStudio/Positron. I am currently learning more about Quarto, GitHub, data visualization, data cleaning, and reproducible workflows.

title: About me
text:
What I Hope to Learn
I want to connect biology with computational tools, especially when I can use data to help explain complex biological systems.

title: About me
text:

Portfolio Direction
This site will continue to grow with course exercises, data visualizations, and projects that show my progress in applied data analysis.
